title: Presentation Embodiments And Dispositions
description: Reconcile @framework/presentation with presentation/AGENTS.md: Video + Pdf embodiments, Disposition model (position/style), analogy template, react-pdf renderer, projektetage live assets.
summary: Aligned @framework/presentation/core with presentation/AGENTS.md: added VideoEmbodiment and PdfEmbodiment; renamed ParticipantPlacement to Disposition with DispositionPosition/DispositionStyle; Arrangement.placements to dispositions; ResolvedPlacement to ResolvedDisposition; added analogy() template. React renderer: react-pdf (pdfjs worker via import.meta.url), VideoMorphView, PdfMorphView, DispositionFrame for absolute positioning, data-auto-animate-id per thought.id. Extended vitest (core 13, renderer 9). Projektetage: second media sequence with public PNG/MP4/PDF and two morph slides (9 arrangements total). Live Playwright check on :6050 confirmed figure, video, pdf render and positioned frames.
